subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: All smartphones are gadgets. Some gadgets are expensive. All expensive things are insured.

Conclusions:

I. Some gadgets are insured.

II. Some smartphones are expensive.
solution:
**Statement: **All smartphones are gadgets. Some gadgets are expensive. All expensive things are insured.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8d8e8fe0a2f5417d2ea4d53cb27d31d08557fc5b4f153d64af5aa00c8218bc8.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some gadgets are insured. - **True **(Because Some gadgets are expensive. All expensive things are insured, which means Some gadgets are insured)

II. Some smartphones are expensive. - False (There is no definite relation between smartphones and expensive, it can be possible only)

Thus, only I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
